  N2 [S] — Population abundance in the second habitat patch

  crowding_sensitivity [P] — Low-to-moderate density strength of symmetric crowding-driven increase in per-capita emigration within a patch
  crowding_saturation [P] — Scale controlling saturation of the crowding effect on per-capita emigration at high local abundance
  adaptation_rate [P] — Rate at which dispersal propensity relaxes toward the instantaneous crowding-based target | suggested range: positive; comparable to, slower than, or moderately faster than dispersal_rate to make lag observable
